subject: [PATCH v9 15/32] mm: swap: share swap-cache allocation error cleanup

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch refactors the error handling in the swap cache allocation function to share common cleanup code between two different error paths. When a post-insertion allocation fails, it removes the folio from the swap cache, restores its shadow, and drops the folio references. This approach simplifies the code and allows for additional checks to reuse this shared cleanup path.
